scope: Requirements extracted from sections 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8; content corrections do not implement application behavior.

requirements.requirement: Check the independent global comfort level of both players. It is not a per-pair value and is not copied from P1 to P2.
P1→P2 and P2→P1 are independent private directed relations. Selection or refusal must not reveal a relation or its asymmetry to participants or the room.
Before publicly addressing a pair, offer P2 a quiet way to decline. Publish neither the private refusal nor its motive; public wording alone is insufficient.
A changed yes_but condition requires a fresh free decision by P1 and explicit confirmation by both for the identical final terms. Either can withdraw; one player's rejection is sufficient to stop.

Private in-person cards remain S3/C1 with bilateral eligible relations. Online private cards require a functioning private text chat for both devices. Offline chat-only cards are unavailable without that chat. Never silently send their answers to the room.
TD-1001, TD-1009, TD-1011 and YB-1009 offer an equivalent written alternative. Text-only players are never forced to use camera, gesture or voice.

min_progression_stage is a minimum threshold: stage 2 can use otherwise eligible stage-1 cards. Private eligibility is still excluded before stage 3. No content-only change may lower private thresholds.
Bind the 21 explicit semantic clusters to scheduling and test cross-mode/same-pair/same-session repetition. A zero token-Jaccard queue is not semantic completeness or scheduling enforcement.

YB-1148 may describe a voluntary agreement not to quote messages. It must not promise to prevent screenshots, copying or retelling. Corrected text remains quarantined under the authoritative HOLD until verified.

Shorten fixed addressing/private prefixes only alongside an actual UX contract preserving context and consent. Verify the edited RU/EN/TR meanings, Turkish individual veto and Unicode with competent reviewers. No human approval is inferred for new hashes.
